name: roblox-parts
description: A 3D game asset built ONLY from classic Roblox parts: rectangular blocks, wedges and corner wedges, like a model made in Roblox Studio. Every surface is flat solid plastic in a single color, with small square Roblox studs on the surfaces. Crisp hard edges and right angles. Chunky, simple, readable proportions with a limited palette. Clean neutral studio lighting with soft, even shading.
avoid: curves, spheres, cylinders, rounded or organic shapes, fur, cloth folds, realistic or painted textures, gradients, outlines, text, logos, watermarks, ground shadows, floors, scenery
notes: Drop up to 6 example screenshots (png/jpg) of part-built Roblox models you like into this folder; they are sent to the image model as style examples.
